profile.headline: Software Engineer | 12+ years of experience | Full Stack | TypeScript | JavaScript | Node.js | Game Developer
profile.summary:
• 12+ years of experience in software engineering.
• Specialized in APIs for distributed systems on cloud platforms.
• Created at least 1 brand new product or service at every company where I have worked.
• Experience leading small teams and mentoring peers.
• Professional work ethic, disciplined, and always willing to learn as a form of continuous improvement.
• Worked for SaaS companies of all sizes: start-up, local government and global enterprise.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Ana, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Lead software engineer in a full-stack team using Next.js, React, Typescript, .NET Core and C#.
• Developed a full-stack SPA to allow commercial real estate agents to create and edit transaction documents from a centralized platform.
• Spearheaded the discussion and documentation of team agreements regarding best practices to ensure consistency in development workflows.
• Drove efforts to refine automated testing procedures and clean up technical debt, improving maintainability and scalability.
• Enforced coding standards and automated testing in PRs as a requirement to prevent unintended regressions.
positions.insights: Skills: React · TypeScript · Next.js · .NET Framework · C# · Playwright

positions.title: Indie Studio Founder | Solo Game Developer
positions.description:
• Solo indie developer with 2+ years of Unity experience.
• Developed and released commercial and experimental projects.
• App Stores: Published a mobile game targeting a casual audience.
• Unity Asset Store: Released and maintain a Unity Editor tool to speed up level design.
• Itch.io: Released 3 small, complete prototypes exploring varied mechanics and game types.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Game Development · Game Design · Unity · Project Management · Marketing

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Senior software engineer in the "core" back-end team.
• Was part of the team that broke down a legacy monolithic service into microservices in 6 months.
• Reduced development cycle for API features by achieving independent deployability of microservices.
• Improved API performance 10x with 99.9% reliability for 2 of the main back end services.
• Analyzed API bottlenecks and implemented solutions to optimize slow endpoints from ~3s down to ~350ms.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Automated Software Testing · Back-end Development · REST APIs · MongoDB · NestJS

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Senior software engineer in the "chat" back-end team.
• Worked remotely both autonomously and as a team contributor with an Europe-based team.
• Integrated SMS and MMS messaging functionality into our clients.
• Designed and implemented support for user reactions to chat messages.
• Added a feature for visual logs for phone calls in user conversations.
• Defined technical requirements for a greenfield project to expand SMS as a source of revenue.
• Developed an MVP to support localized SMS messages directly from chat for European and Australian users.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · REST APIs · Node.js · MongoDB · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead software engineer with a team of 3 junior engineers.
• Developed a versatile platform that could be used by industries with a field workforce.
• Had regular in-person meetings with external stakeholders to help define business use cases, then extract technical requirements.
• Improved end user productivity by reducing the data capture and reporting cycle from ~4 hours to ~30 minutes.
• Developed a product that allows users to easily download digital copies of real estate records to establish a new source of revenue.
positions.insights: Skills: Relational Data Modeling · Mentoring · JavaScript · Technical Requirements Gathering · Team Leadership · Geographic Information Systems (GIS)

positions.title: Support Engineer
positions.locationName: Lake Forest, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Electrical engineer in the customer support team.
• Developed test plans, calibrated and programmed electrical test equipment in-house.
• Deployed assembled stations at the customer's site, and trained the customer's staff how to use automated testing equipment.
positions.insights: Skills: Electrical Engineering · Programming · Technical Support · Debugging

projects.title: Pattern Painter
projects.description: A Unity tool that saves time during your game development process by allowing you to place Game Object in your scene in geometric patterns.

projects.title: Tap n' Pop!
projects.description: A cartoon-themed game where you pop as many balloons as you can in a 1 minute span to try and beat the high score.
